articles.headline: Rays clinch ALCS with Game 6 win, to face Brewers in World Series
articles.description: Junior Caminero hit his first career postseason home run off Guardians All-Star closer Cade Smith in the seventh inning Monday as the Rays went on to clinch the AL pennant and advance to a World Series matchup with the Brewers.

images.name: Junior Caminero [600x400]
images.caption: Just before concluding his 38.7-second home run trot, Junior Caminero crossed his arms across his chest with a stone stare at Randy Arozarena behind home plate, mimicking the celebration Arozarena made famous while fueling the Rays’ 2020 World Series run.
